AI Agents Digest 2026-10-10

Generated: 2026-10-10 01:52 UTC | Projects: 12 | Active today: 7 | Stable releases: 2 | Prereleases (not covered): 8

🕵️ Stealth Models on OpenRouter

No stealth models listed on OpenRouter today.

Overview

Claude Code shipped v2.1.296 adding gateway policy support for Claude Desktop's Code tab and subagent auto-compact configuration, while GitHub Copilot CLI v1.0.95 brought native Microsoft Entra authentication to macOS. Claude Code's auto-mode classifier is blocking account owners from running their own scheduled Cowork routines and transferring files between their machines, and a separate report shows Opus 4.6 running at 200K context instead of the documented 500K on Max plans. Gemini CLI's strict RFC 9207 enforcement breaks MCP OAuth with providers like Atlassian that don't support the "iss" field. Qwen Code has a daemon git worktree guard vulnerability where heredoc bodies fed to shells still execute, and Hermes Agent misclassifies new sk-ant-usr- personal API keys as OAuth tokens, causing credit balance errors.

Claude Code

  • Release: v2.1.296 adds a code key to the Claude apps gateway's managed policies for Claude Desktop's Code tab, and introduces autoCompactWindow in subagent frontmatter so subagents can compact earlier than the main conversation. Release
  • Hot issue: Auto mode classifier blocks the account owner's own scheduled Cowork routines and file transfers between their own machines, a regression since late September. Issue #100730
  • Hot issue: Merged Claude app runs Opus 4.6 at 200K context on Max 5x plans (help center documents 500K), leaving only ~50K per compaction cycle after ~92K fixed overhead. Issue #100502

GitHub Copilot CLI

  • Release: v1.0.95 enables native Microsoft Entra broker authentication on macOS with browser fallback, adds sandbox credential injectHosts keys to copilot config with shell completion, and fixes --context to apply to new and resumed ACP sessions. Release

Gemini CLI

  • Hot issue: Strict RFC 9207 enforcement in MCP OAuth blocks providers like Atlassian that don't advertise an "iss" field in discovery metadata; an opt-in config is proposed. Issue #29681

OpenCode

  • Hot issue: Cannot connect to API through fixed networks with self-signed certificates even when the root CA is installed locally; suggests Node.js --use-system-ca flag as workaround. Issue #54095

Qwen Code

  • Hot issue: Feature request for /auto-mode-setup command to ground the auto-mode classifier with local environment context (project type, build tools, package managers). Issue #13691
  • Hot issue: Daemon git worktree guard strips heredoc bodies before parsing, but when the receiver is a shell or interpreter the stripped body still executes as program code — a security vulnerability. Issue #13705

Hermes Agent

  • Hot issue: _is_oauth_token() misclassifies new Console personal API keys (sk-ant-usr-) as OAuth tokens, injecting Claude Code identity and failing requests with "credit balance too low". Issue #135376

QwenPaw

  • Hot issue: Chat history disappears unexpectedly; user argues this is unrelated to model context window and demands a fix. Issue #8134

Quiet today: OpenAI Codex, Pi, OpenClaw, IronClaw, ZeroClaw
